question.text: The variation of impedance Z of a series LCR circuit with frequency of the source is shown in the figure. Which of the following statement(s) is/are true?

options.text: The impedance Z is inductive in the portion AC
The impedance Z is capacitive in the portion BC
The impedance Z is inductive in the portion BC
The impedance Z is capacitive in the portion AC

solution.text: $A C: X_L \lt X_C \Rightarrow$ capacitive nature $B C: X_L \gt X_C \Rightarrow$ Inductive nature
